finalText:
**Big but mostly mechanical.** 1291 hits in 94 files.

| Keep `account_id` here | Why |
|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml:16](docs/openapi.yaml:16), [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) right side | Public API. Frozen. |
| `migrations/*.sql`, 12 files | Applied history. Add one new `RENAME COLUMN` migration. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` wipes edits. |

Three more traps. 125 SQL strings need the new migration first. 25 inserts put `account_id` in the JSONB `payload`. Old rows keep the old key. `req.session.account_id` comes from outside this repo. 100 call sites read it.

Next: sign off with the carve-outs written in.
